title: lncRNAfunc: a knowledgebase of lncRNA function in human cancer.
authors: Yang, Mengyuan; Lu, Huifen; Liu, Jiajia; Wu, Sijia; Kim, Pora; Zhou, Xiaobo
one_liner_zh: 该文构建人类癌症lncRNA功能知识库，虽涉及lncRNA与DNA/蛋白互作及转录因子招募，但以数据库资源为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且非TF-DNA互作核心体系。
abstract: The long non-coding RNAs associating with other molecules can coordinate several physiological processes and their dysfunction can impact diverse human diseases. To date, systematic and intensive annotations on diverse interaction regulations of lncRNAs in human cancer were not available. Here, we built lncRNAfunc, a knowledgebase of lncRNA function in human cancer at https://ccsm.uth.edu/lncRNAfunc, aiming to provide a resource and reference for providing therapeutically targetable lncRNAs and intensive interaction regulations. To do this, we collected 15 900 lncRNAs across 33 cancer types from TCGA. For individual lncRNAs, we performed multiple interaction analyses of different biomolecules including DNA, RNA, and protein levels. Our intensive studies of lncRNAs provide diverse potential mechanisms of lncRNAs that regulate gene expression through binding enhancers and 3'-UTRs of genes, competing for miRNA binding sites with mRNAs, recruiting the transcription factors to gene promoters. Furthermore, we investigated lncRNAs that potentially affect the alternative splicing events through interacting with RNA binding Proteins. We also performed multiple functional annotations including cancer stage-associated lncRNAs, RNA A-to-I editing event-associated lncRNAs, and lncRNA expression quantitative trait loci. lncRNAfunc is a unique resource for cancer research communities to help better understand potential lncRNA regulations and therapeutic lncRNA targets.
abstract_zh: 与其他分子相关的长链非编码RNA能够协调多种生理过程，其功能失调可影响多种人类疾病。迄今为止，关于lncRNA在人类癌症中多种相互作用调控的系统性和深入注释尚不可得。在此，我们构建了lncRNAfunc，一个关于人类癌症中lncRNA功能的知识库，网址为https://ccsm.uth.edu/lncRNAfunc，旨在为提供可靶向治疗的lncRNA及深入的相互作用调控提供资源和参考。为此，我们从TCGA收集了33种癌症类型中的15 900个lncRNA。针对单个lncRNA，我们进行了包括DNA、RNA和蛋白质水平在内的不同生物分子的多种相互作用分析。我们对lncRNA的深入研究揭示了lncRNA通过结合增强子和基因3'-UTR、与mRNA竞争miRNA结合位点、招募转录因子至基因启动子来调控基因表达的多种潜在机制。此外，我们研究了可能通过与RNA结合蛋白相互作用影响选择性剪接事件的lncRNA。我们还进行了多种功能注释，包括与癌症分期相关的lncRNA、RNA A-to-I编辑事件相关的lncRNA以及lncRNA表达数量性状位点。lncRNAfunc是癌症研究社区的一个独特资源，有助于更好地理解潜在的lncRNA调控和治疗性lncRNA靶点。
